steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Setup folder configuration and packages for Simple Notes Hub.

steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Create app-meta.json containing metadata configuration details.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Configure app/build.gradle with Gradle 8.5, AGP 8.3.2 and Java 8 targeting properties.

steps.title: Setup Manifest File
steps.description: Configure system launcher activity, app title label and system theme definitions.

steps.title: Setup Database Helper
steps.description: Create custom Notes SQLite database schemas and open handler components inside MainActivity.

steps.title: Design main layout XML
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml utilizing layouts to host list view state and note editor state controls dynamically.

steps.title: Implement Note Data Model
steps.description: Construct serializable Note model containing title, content, category and date properties.

steps.title: Initialize UI Element Bindings
steps.description: Bind text inputs, list layout, search, filters, category spinners and action widgets in onCreate.

steps.title: Populate Category Adapter Sets
steps.description: Setup spinner adapter targets loaded with custom tag options: Work, Personal, Ideas, Shopping, Others.

steps.title: Build Notes List BaseAdapter
steps.description: Implement custom BaseAdapter mapping model data dynamically to styled rows and color-coded category labels.

steps.title: Setup Realtime Filter TextWatcher
steps.description: Create a text watcher checking input on note lists and update list adapter elements dynamically.

steps.title: Bind Workspace Filter Spinner
steps.description: Bind select callbacks on spinner configurations to change listing subsets in real-time.

steps.title: Implement Save Action logic
steps.description: Write validation flows, check non-empty inputs and execute insert or update SQLite queries.

steps.title: Implement Delete Operations
steps.description: Design dynamic interactive confirm alerts before deleting database entries on target nodes.

steps.title: Manage View Visibility transitions
steps.description: Configure list layouts and edit layouts visibility swaps for fluid user navigation operations.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Review MainActivity code files for absolute Java 8 targeting layout compliance.

steps.title: Building Simple Notes Hub
steps.description: Initiate gradle assemble tasks to create native APK bundles and verify system layouts output compiles correctly.
